name: Combustible Gas & CO Sensor
description: Industrial safety nose! Detects carbon monoxide and flammable hydrocarbon gas leaks.
realWorldAnalogy: Industrial safety nose! Detects carbon monoxide and flammable hydrocarbon gas leaks.

hazards: Testing with live gas sources is strictly prohibited without adults
safety.childSafeAlternative: Simulate with a potentiometer or test with safe unlit lighter puff under adult eye

wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate) to GND, and A0 (Yellow) to analog pin A1.
commonMistakes: Attempting to test with real open gas sources without adult supervision.
Testing before the heating element has completed warm-up.

miniExperiment.title: Combustible Gas Sniffer
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, A0 to Analog Pin A1.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Steady baseline readings in clean ambient air (~80-140).
